title: Add autonomy review artifact verifier
summary: Unsigned review artifacts now export task evidence, but there is no command that fails closed when a generated artifact drifts from the task record or event log. Add a read-only verifier that checks schema, safe source paths, task metadata, event selection, and digests before signing work begins.
expectedFailureModes: A review artifact with stale task metadata or event digests is accepted as evidence.
The verifier accepts absolute or traversal source paths from an artifact.
The verifier writes files, stages changes, commits, or pushes while only checking review evidence.
nextAction: Add an autonomy-verify-review-artifact command for JSON from stdin or file, document the verifier, update status evidence, and validate generated plus tampered artifact paths without writing Git metadata.
